title: Kyle Shanahan says Nick Bosa is "making a lot of progress" in rehab

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan says Nick Bosa is "making a lot of progress" in rehab
sources.description: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa has not practiced since Aug. 3 with soreness and tendinitis in his surgically repaired right knee. 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan did not provide a timeline for Bosa on Tuesday.
